database.reason: Schema epoch 3 admits original gallery assets below 50 MB without the previous 20MP constraint via dsapi_005_gallery_official_input_limits.sql. Older applications still enforce 32MiB/20MP and may reject these new assets, so rollback across this boundary requires the pre-release database backup and matching object-storage recovery planning. Migration 254 adds private ticket attachments and nullable operation identifiers. Migration 255 adds announcement display_mode with legacy rows defaulting to timeline; existing content, schedules, targeting and first-read records are retained. This does not change model routing or billing. Official v0.2.21 appends 249_add_usage_logs_api_key_cost_index_notx.sql (a concurrent covering index) and 250_openai_cache_write_ttl.sql (additive cache TTL usage/pricing columns). Existing migration filenames and checksums remain unchanged; migrations are tracked by full filename, including on databases already at 255.
